name: Four Seasons Resort Palm Beach
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary sits on one of Florida's most pristine stretches of sand, where old Palm Beach glamour meets contemporary luxury.
whats_special: The resort occupies a prime location on Palm Beach's exclusive coastline, featuring the island's only beachfront spa and direct access to crystal-clear Atlantic waters. The property's signature restaurant showcases locally-sourced Florida ingredients with stunning ocean views, while the resort maintains the intimate feel of a private club with just 210 rooms across 6 acres.
pro_tip: Book the oceanfront suites on the north side for unobstructed sunrise views and better beach access – they're worth the upgrade and often available through our exclusive partnerships.
dont_miss: The legendary Worth Avenue shopping district is just steps away, offering world-class boutiques and galleries. Take advantage of the resort's complimentary beach service and try stand-up paddleboarding in the calm morning waters. The rooftop Eau Spa treatments using marine-based therapies are exceptional and capitalize on the oceanfront setting.
pros: Prime oceanfront location with direct beach access
Exceptional Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Elegant rooms and suites with ocean views
